admissions_information_for_tracker.topic: Peking University Health Science Center 2027 Clinical Medicine
admissions_information_for_tracker.finding: 2027 undergraduate guide published; Clinical Medicine is Chinese-taught, so not an English MBBS target. CSC Type A requires CSCA Math, Physics, Chemistry, with test language Chinese or English; this does not change teaching language.
Official 2026 FAQ says CSC Type A/B not available for MBBS; 2027 still unconfirmed. No application fee in 2026, freshman scholarships ¥5,000–34,000.
Separate Kazakhstan funding route restricted from 2026 to eligible I–III international olympiad/science project winners on approved list; direct English MBBS eligibility not established for 2027.
